## Frozen pixelelated inputs — 2026-10-04

Ocean Bands is integrated into the actual splash renderer, ES and theme. Distribution **b137d8c37323abbf07788af8bf8dbd495a31e9c9** (feature c12c0e1b30), ES **c75aa3fac967ba532fd9ba1c21fa10ca024e8bc1**, splash **8c71126ceef702528c87a4c49625e64988609f26**, and RAOfflineProxy **ec60fdd0f6522790d9d1d4d20add397bbc4da945** are published and pinned. Native Ocean output matches the canonical composition pixel for pixel; all rotations, exact colors/gaps, actual ES NanoSVG parsing and package/identity checks pass. Source receipts: `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-04-pixelelated-ocean/`.

A separate clean `/workspace/repos/rocknix.worktrees/m7-pixelelated` checkout on `build/m7-pixelelated` is frozen at b137d8c373. Run owner `/workspace/tmp/pixelelated-m7-cold-01` holds the immutable launcher and input manifest (SHA256 c83828fa6013666811b044fb0842b3f493a6237366206a26bea3c645d041ca79): 6,547 regular source files, 180 symlinks and 1,608 recipes. The pinned pixelelated container is pulled; global24/WebKit4. No warm build root was copied.

**No build is running and no pixelelated image exists.** Preflight still finds approximately8GiB swap full despite44GiB available RAM. Interactive sudo is required to recycle `/swap.img`; the owner action is pending. No memory setting was changed. Next: clear that host blocker, pass preflight, run the frozen launcher through the shared5s/5min watcher, then retain and qualify the exact image. A real host/container watcher probe completed with rc0 at03:04:34UTC and its completion was reported. Active-session supervision is available; disconnected delivery remains unresolved in #395.

The final source preflight refresh adds four upstream proxy commits; packaged Python changes only the alpha2 version string. All15 patches apply with zero fuzz,199 upstream and8 fork tests pass; coupled submodules are unchanged. Complete package freshness exits0. D-WORKFLOW-147 records the already-qualified SPIR-V parent coupling; receipts: `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-04-proxy-preflight/`. These source checks do not replace candidate VM evidence or the remaining ordinary RA account fixture.

## Historical replacement02 qualification — 2026-10-04

**Historical scope: M7.P3 replacement02 tests, before the pixelelated rename.** Replacement02 is frozen at61b64817bf8ab48237e51abb395484e36cbf924b; immutable bundle87b8c01d65dc22b4f29049bd0d69307a59c14c16f5223534e95058b2234ca5cd, image SHA f1af353331dfb1da9911b34db6b19d124feed28f59c669f3c046704acde93f47. Final evidence is published on next20a21a8e40 (feature3a135aa5ed); the build was not advanced for documentation.

**Completed on this exact image:** all15 default suites PASS,0FAIL/0SKIP;16 UI walks/78 walk frames plus16 timing frames; baseline comparison; actual RC2 upgrade; exact clean/upgraded script/policy readbacks. Installed proxy20, S3 failed-listing10, explicit-root/sentence22, selected-archive journal8, final actual-upgraded archive14, timing4 and identity11 assertions PASS. Installed exit-sync medians264ms legacy/241ms current are23ms apart within the unchanged30ms limit; every transfer hash matches, no source override. Candidate custody verified before/after. Main QA finished23:54:39UTC and final runtime23:56:11UTC on October3, runner/watcher/outer0. All owned guests/backends are stopped; no job or unattended notification is armed.

**Verified closures:** #380/#407/#408 plus #364/#376/#377/#379/#381/#357. Each issue body maps its own old negative controls and artifact-scoped evidence. Earlier original503e and replacement134e proofs, fixture failures, timing failures and outer143 discrepancy remain retained. Current archive selection preserves D-CLOUD-067 console fallback and D-CLOUD-156/162 UI eligibility separately.

**Earlier remaining order (now preceded by the pixelelated build and repeat qualification):** (1) finish P3 identity/manual-update/brand/secret/localisation and source/licence/readiness mapping; targeted checks are not a universal sweep; (2) complete the live ordinary-mode RA award/reconnect proof when the earlier test-account fixture answer arrives; (3) approved P4 primary+Fable5.1/xhigh Facilitator fixes audit, resolve findings and requalify affected bytes; (4) separately gated P5 release staging and first H700 DDR4/RG35XX SP build/device work. No RC claim.

**External inputs:** ordinary Tobu100359 is already earned; owner reset or alternate QA account remains pending. Public-site screenshot4f6df54 is local only after maxengel/rocknix.org denied Blitterbot403. #395 needs a selected, tested disconnected delivery destination. During this batch active-session supervision reported failures, completions and suspected inactivity, with shared5s detailed-log monitoring/5min inactivity detection; the recorder alone cannot notify after disconnection.

**Evidence:** [full default/upgrade receipts](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/20a21a8e407728818823cfe7e430b970b78a6c66/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-03-m7-replacement02-qualification), [final runtime and criterion map](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/20a21a8e407728818823cfe7e430b970b78a6c66/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-03-m7-final-runtime). Canonical checkpoint retains paths, owners and preserved earlier evidence.

The [M7 milestone body](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/milestone/7) owns the execution order.

## Historical reconciliation (superseded current status above)

### First-release reconciliation — 2026-10-02 (#385)

`docs/rasteratops/release-readiness.md` maps the current goals, source, evidence and release gates. Not RC-ready: no combined 0.0.1 image exists. Feature fcd0f20c9a / next df23faff6c contains the cloud/identity fixes; the 1,367-pass host receipt predates the latest input refresh and is not image qualification. Initial independent audit #375/#382 is complete; its five product fixes await candidate evidence. Keep working version 0.0.1.

Source-freeze prerequisites include #356 versioned/retryable migration, #320 settings recovery, #361/#362 and #386 dependency reconciliation, #310/#327/#332 carry-forward software/evidence, and #365 actor/state coverage. RC2 bug exceptions are removed from rc-accept.txt, not renewed for this release. #383 retains the authorized regression→fix→combined-image→independent-fixes-review order. Publication, personal-cloud and physical-device actions remain separate.


## Maintainer's request

> let's proceed with all 4 in the order you've outlined

The approved order is regression coverage, remediation, combined branded build and VM qualification, then review of the fixes. This continues #344/#354 after the completed readiness audit #375 and disposition tracker #382. The five product findings remain open: #376, #377, #379, #380, #381. Bot identity is complete. OS identity source is implemented; its combined-image qualification is not.

## Can this be done on the VM?

Yes. Host isolated production-script regressions precede GENERIC_X64 clean-install, RC2-upgrade, pair, visual and timing proofs. No personal cloud or physical-device action is needed for this work. Handheld staging and publication remain separate actions.

## Ordered acceptance criteria

- [x] #365's T01–T26 table maps each relevant actor/state cell to executable assertions or a justified inapplicable cell; #356 adds strict supported-version, numbered-step, marker-failure and interrupted retry/fleet controls; #320 has deterministic recovery-race controls; writer-shaped archive discovery is the first negative control. The promoted guest proof resets every case and exits nonzero on an injected assertion failure.
- [ ] #376/#377/#379/#380/#381 and #365 settlement, #363 card ordering, #364 timing, #366 fixture defects have source fixes and retained passing/failing controls. Each owning issue carries its own evidence.
- [ ] #361/#362/#386 input refresh and preservation checks pass; #310/#327/#332 carry-forward software criteria and host gates are resolved. #337's approved OS identity is integrated on the frozen upstream baseline. One recorded input set produces the candidate; clean install, RC2 upgrade, full VM QA, pair migration, visual and timing evidence identify that build.
- [ ] The code-auditor review of the fixes includes the approved independent other-lab model through the Facilitator; findings are resolved and any resulting product changes rebuilt and requalified before an RC claim.

## Delivery checkpoints

Prior retro: docs/retros/2026-10-02-cloud-runs-95-101.md. Audit: docs/audits/2026_10_02-milestone-375-rasteratops-0-0-1/. The completed historical kickoff futro and execution checklist are recorded in docs/futros/2026-10-02-rc-remediation.md. No checklist above is closed by the earlier audit's administrative completion.

## P1 source exit — 2026-10-03

Completed actor/predecessor map, promoted guest recovery controls, #391 conservative inherited-state recovery and #392 no-remote refusal. Final host proof:1,367 harness plus322 focused PASS,0 FAIL/0 SKIP; receipts in `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-03-m7-coverage/`. The first checkbox records the source/coverage prerequisite, not guest qualification. P2 current proxy/dependencies are next; no branded build exists and all required candidate image criteria remain open.

## M7.P3 cold engineering build started — 2026-10-03 14:02 UTC

P1/P2 source gates and approved ES/splash publications are complete. Normal
pushes, remote hash readbacks, package lint and final package freshness pass.
Can this be done on the VM? Yes: this is the GENERIC_X64 engineering artifact
required for the candidate clean/upgrade/provider/pair/UI/memory proofs.

Frozen distribution503e24e10dde6a59aa6c631f789b88b89f8e92e1;
ESe6e1e4d0f91e177e182cc05b1cea74991e1cc45b;
product splash7450aa8180ae66684814dd460f31eb502b2abf61.
Actual running container is the pinned Rasteratops
sha256:988c0ba586263caeba4be4c03bd16eee055c9d066657951e320087bb8226ee39,
user1000:1000, with main.git and shared source-cache mounts verified.
The new root is build.RASTERATOPS-GENERIC_X64.x86_64, in isolated
build/m7-generic-x64. Global24 jobs, WebKit-j4. No warm root copied/renamed.

Input manifest SHA25624116729b3610411fe5ba89543cf10db98b11cb9ca8afc3cbf0ef61f08640459
records1,608 recipes and hashes of tracked build inputs. Live receipts:
`/workspace/tmp/rasteratops-m7-cold-01/{inputs.json,build.log,build.pid,build.rc,build.status}`.
Build PID3863117; actual host watcher3863200,30s heartbeat. build.rc does not
exist until exit. The consumed container receipt is beside the manifest.

Next: monitor/resolve cold-build failures, retain the resulting artifact in
candidate-store and verify its digest, then execute the ordered P3 evidence
matrix. No image exists yet and no candidate checkbox is ticked from launch.
P4 independent fixes review remains required; existing audit cadence stays red
until it is actually completed. No physical/personal-cloud action occurred.

## Fresh P3 resume check — 2026-10-03

The fresh read-only agent verified the live build/watcher, frozen distro/ES
identity, and all6,606 manifest files with no missing/mismatched bytes.
It found two stale active-status sentences: the readiness document's opening
still said freeze/integration pending, and this issue's opening still named P2.
Both openings are corrected and the fresh agent re-read them: PASS, no
unresolved handoff defect. Proof: docs/qa-logs/2026-10-03-m7-cold-01/handoff-proof.md. No product or live build file changes. Historical review sections
retain their dated baseline rather than being silently rewritten.


## First branded engineering image and watcher proof — 2026-10-03 16:33 UTC

Cold build01 completed642/642 tasks and image assembly, rc0. The corrected
watcher4085803 recorded finished/rc0 at16:34:02UTC and exited. The old
watcher3863200 had misreported buffered WebKit output as a stall; #393 adds
actual package-log activity and28 passing lifecycle controls. #394 routes
future native/Docker entrypoints automatically, with34 passing runner/routing
controls and an actual pinned Docker smoke at a different mount path.
Status recording is armed automatically; chat notification is not available.

Both emitted image/update SHA256 files verify against actual bytes. Immutable
candidate-store custody passes for bundle
`/workspace/artifacts/rasteratops-candidates/sha256/83751e812351c72fc80a6a3cf418929769158684345cf6dd5f9e0fbcd9877d21`.
Its inputs remain frozen distribution503e24e10d, ESe6e1e4d0f; all6,606 input
hashes reverified. Only build-generated emulator-support documentation is
dirty in that checkout; preserve it. Tool changes do not alter the image.

#393/#394 are delivered. Next: collect actual consumed-source/download inventory,
then run the P3 image matrix and approved P4 fixes audit. No RC claim or
candidate qualification checkbox is closed by build success. Evidence:
`docs/qa-logs/2026-10-03-watch-job/` and `2026-10-03-m7-cold-01/`.

Fresh resume proof verified all6,606 inputs and the bundle. Its terminal-warning and historical-label findings are corrected; current terminal status explicitly says heartbeat stops here. Final readback recorder48573 exited normally at16:59:43UTC.


## Completion delivery and first-device route — 2026-10-03

The maintainer requires completion notices (#395, D-WORKFLOW-143). The
automatic recorder/routing work #393/#394 remains delivered; real notification
delivery is a separate open item. The off-session destination is not yet
selected. Do not infer that a status file can alert a disconnected session.

Product order remains P3 source inventory and clean/upgrade/provider/pair/
performance/UI qualification, P4 approved independent fixes review, then
H700 DDR4/RG35XX SP artifact verification and the named migration/smoke
actions. The current GENERIC_X64 image is a VM artifact, not a handheld image.
The live M7 body was updated and read back with that order.


## Continuation request

> Perfect. Let's continue the build process wherever we've left off and see if we can't get to a fully testable build that passes all of our VM tests, and we'll be ready for device testing.

M7.P3 remains the active phase. The cold-build input freeze above is complete; source completion is not an RC claim. Full default and required opt-in/provider/pair/upgrade/visual/performance evidence must identify the new bytes, followed by remaining P3 criteria and P4 before the H700 DDR4 artifact/device route.
